claim: Let \(m\ge2\) and let \(\rho_x=\frac{m-x}{m^3-m}I+\frac{mx-1}{m^3-m}F\), \(x\in[0,1]\), be the \(m\otimes m\) Werner state used by Guo, with \(F\) the flip and two-sided Hilbert--Schmidt measurement-induced nonlocality \(N_{AB}(\rho)=\max_{\Pi^{ab}}\|\rho-\Pi^{ab}(\rho)\|_2^2\). Put \(b=(mx-1)/(m^3-m)\). Among all sequences \(\tau_r\to\rho_x\) in trace norm for which both marginals of every \(\tau_r\) are nondegenerate, the complete set of subsequential limits of \(N_{AB}(\tau_r)\) is exactly \[\boxed{\left[b^2(m^2-m),\ b^2(m^2-1)\right]=\left[\frac{m}{m+1}N_{AB}(\rho_x),\ N_{AB}(\rho_x)\right].}\] Here \(N_{AB}(\rho_x)=b^2(m^2-1)\). Equivalently, at every nontrivial Werner state \(x\ne1/m\), the generic nondegenerate-marginal stratum has exact local oscillation width \(N_{AB}(\rho_x)/(m+1)\). More precisely, if the limiting eigenbases of the two marginals have overlap unitary \(U\), then the limit is \(b^2[m^2-S(U)]\), where \(S(U)=\sum_{i,j}|U_{ij}|^4\). Since \(S(U)\) ranges over the full interval \([1,m]\), every value in the displayed interval occurs. The lower endpoint is attained by aligned limiting bases and the upper endpoint by mutually unbiased limiting bases. Thus Guo\'s qualitative Werner-state discontinuity example admits a complete, dimension-explicit local cluster-set classification.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic finite-dimensional replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Complete cluster set over nondegenerate-marginal approaches to a Werner state, including exact dimension-normalized oscillation width.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record lists 81P15 first, followed by 81P40.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: Guo is credited with two-sided MiN, its qualitative noncontinuity, the Werner example, and the aligned-versus-mutually-unbiased perturbation idea.
integrity.source_date_basis: arXiv:1204.0565 v1 was first submitted on 2012-04-03.

scientific_limitations: The cluster-set classification is for approaches through states with both marginals nondegenerate.
The measure is Guo\'s squared Hilbert--Schmidt two-sided measurement-induced nonlocality, not trace-, fidelity-, affinity-, or entropy-based variants.
The theorem is specific to the Werner family.
A general stratified-optimization result elsewhere could imply the same interval under different terminology.
title: Exact generic-stratum discontinuity interval of two-sided measurement-induced nonlocality at Werner states
